name: InterMIND API
description: InterMIND is a communication space where every meeting is understood in 20+ languages. This API lets a tool create and schedule meetings on behalf of a user, list their meetings, read recaps and transcripts, search recaps, read and post in their channels, list shared documents, and subscribe a webhook that fires the moment a recap is ready. Authenticate with a personal API key (InterMIND → Settings → API keys) or the token an OAuth connection minted, as a bearer token. A key carries the rights it was created with: keys from before v1.1 open only /me, POST /meetings, /recaps and /webhooks — the other endpoints answer 403 until the app is reconnected or a new key is created.
